events.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
events.summary: A zero-day authentication bypass flaw (CVE-2026-76460) was discovered in Cisco Identity Services Engine, allowing attackers to bypass authentication. The vulnerability has a maximum CVSS score of 10 and is listed as a KEV.
events.why_it_matters: The flaw has a CVSS score of 10, indicating a critical risk. It is listed in the KEV, meaning it is known to be actively exploited or has high potential for exploitation. Defenders should prioritize patching Cisco ISE deployments immediately.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-76460 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-09-16, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-09-19.
CVE-2026-76460 is rated 10.0 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-76460 being exploited in the next 30 days at 14%.

timeline.summary: First reported by CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

events.title: Tiny gold particles power golden staph colour test
events.summary: With more than a million fatalities each year, golden staph is a major human pathogen and leading cause of infection-related deaths globally. Using tiny gold particles that behave like artificial enzymes (nanozymes) combined with short DNA molecular binders to create colour ‘fingerprints’ unique to each strain, a colour test for golden staph has been developed. These fingerprints, researchers say, can help separate high-risk strains from others and inform next steps of care.
